# Review packet: Airbnb listing rewrite for The Overhang (Janesville, WI)

## Airbnb guidance found (Nov 1, 2026 research, with sources)
- Airbnb Fall Update (Sept 30, 2026, news.airbnb.com/airbnb-2026-fall-update): AI search in the guest's own words or voice; AI filters (typed words map to ticked amenities); AI-written descriptions in search results that highlight a home's key features; AI comparison of wishlisted homes.
- Q2 2026 shareholder letter: AI generates listing highlights from host descriptions and guest reviews; search ranking prioritizes higher-quality homes that fit the trip.
- Help article 39 (How search results work): quality (photos, ratings, reviews, communication, listing characteristics, cancellations, amenities), popularity (wishlists, bookings, messages), total price vs similar nearby, location, personalization.
- Title guidance (resources article 533): fewer than 50 characters, lead with what matters, no repeated symbols or emojis, sentence case.
- Description guidance (article 369): be specific, showcase special features, include practical planning details. Accuracy is a scored quality factor.
- Off-platform rule (help 2799): no links, contact details or book-direct offers in listing text.
- Not published by Airbnb: which listing fields AI search reads or how each is weighted.

## The listing as it is live today
TITLE: The Overhang • Architect-Designed + Sauna/Hot Tub
LISTING HEADER (set by Airbnb from listing fields): Entire cabin in Janesville, Wisconsin. 10 guests, 4 bedrooms, 5 beds, 3.5 baths. Top guest favorite, 5.0 from 27 reviews. Subscores: cleanliness 5.0, accuracy 5.0, check-in 5.0, communication 5.0, location 4.9, value 4.8.
AIRBNB AUTO "LISTING HIGHLIGHTS": Top 5% of homes. On the Rock River in Janesville: On a private bluff above the Rock River, with Rock River Heritage County Park steps away. Outdoor sauna, hot tub, and fire pit: A private sauna, hot tub, and fire pit sit beneath the cantilevered structure overlooking the river. Thoughtful design, attentive host.
REVIEW TOPIC CHIPS: Hot tub 9, River 4, Cleanliness 8, Comfort 8, Family 7, Hospitality 10, Amenities 6, Sleep quality 6, Indoor spaces 7, Accuracy 5.

SUMMARY:
Less than 2 hours from Chicago. 45 minutes from Madison. Sleeps 10.
The Overhang is an architect-designed retreat on a private bluff above the Rock River. Charred-wood siding. A massive circular window framing the water. An outdoor sauna and hot tub beneath the cantilever. Four king bedrooms, a fire bowl patio, a private theater downstairs. Built for families, friend groups, and milestone weekends.
Some escapes give you a place to sleep. The Overhang gives you a place to exhale.

THE SPACE:
The Overhang is an architect-designed retreat on a private bluff above the Rock River, less than 2 hours from Chicago, 45 minutes from Madison. Charred-wood siding, a massive circular window framing the water, an outdoor sauna and hot tub beneath the cantilevered structure. Sleeps 10 across four king bedrooms and a queen sofa bed.
It's a brand-new home, built for the kind of long weekends you actually remember: families spread across four bedrooms, friends gathered around the fire bowl, slow mornings that start with the river running below.
UPPER LEVEL, GATHER, COOK & TAKE IN THE VIEW
The upper level is the heart of the home. Soaring reclaimed-wood ceiling beams. A massive circular window framing a living portrait of the river. A chef's kitchen with an oversized island built for long meals and good conversation. A fireplace anchors the living room. Hammock chair, board games, fully stocked coffee bar. The pullout queen sofa accommodates larger groups.
MAIN LEVEL, REST & RESET
Three king bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a spa-inspired bath with a microcement tub. A kitchenette makes late-night snacks and early-morning coffee easy. Step directly outside to the hot tub, sauna, and fire bowl patio overlooking the river bluff.
LOWER LEVEL, PLAY, WATCH & DISAPPEAR
A dedicated movie theater with a large screen and full surround sound. An arcade with classic games. A fourth king bedroom and full bathroom. This level is designed to disappear into, perfect for kids and teens, late-night movies, or guests who want a little extra privacy.
OUTDOOR SPACES
The hot tub sits beneath the cantilevered structure, feeling like it floats above the river. The sauna is a proper retreat, a small wood-lined room with a window to the trees. The fire bowl patio is where most evenings end: open sky, river below, nowhere else to be.
In cold weather the contrast between the sauna and the night air is the whole point. And in any season, first light over the river, best seen with coffee, from the upper-level window, is the part of the day people remember most.
Mature trees and complete privacy from neighboring properties make every season feel intentional.
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
Bedroom 1: King bed (Main Level). Bedroom 2: King bed (Main Level). Bedroom 3: King bed (Main Level). Bedroom 4: King bed (Lower Level). Living Room: Pullout queen sofa (Upper Level). Comfortably sleeps 8 to 10.
PERFECT FOR
Families and multigenerational trips. There's space for everyone, four real beds for the adults, and a lower level the kids can take over.
Friend groups marking a milestone: 40th birthdays, anniversaries, bachelorette and bachelor weekends, girls' weekends.
Multi-family escapes where two households share a house and nobody draws the short straw on bedrooms.
Small corporate retreats and team offsites for groups of 8 to 10.
Guests who value privacy, craftsmanship, and calm over crowds and check-the-box amenities.
LOCATION & DRIVE TIMES
Janesville sits at the intersection of I-90/39, easy from anywhere in the Upper Midwest.
Chicago Loop: under 2 hours. O'Hare Airport: about 90 minutes. Madison & UW campus: 45 minutes. Milwaukee: 75 minutes. Lake Geneva: 50 minutes. Rockford, IL: 40 minutes. New Glarus: 35 minutes. Galena, IL: 90 minutes.
Close enough to reach easily. Far enough to feel away.
WHAT TO DO NEARBY
Rotary Botanical Gardens (15 minutes) is a beautiful place to spend an afternoon. New Glarus Brewing, Wisconsin's most beloved craft brewery, is a 35-minute drive. Madison's State Street, Memorial Union Terrace, and Capitol Square are all within 45 minutes. Beloit's Ironworks district and the historic Beloit College campus are 15 minutes south. Lake Geneva is 50 minutes east when you want lake-town energy without staying in the crowds. For longer stays, Galena, IL, a beautifully preserved 19th-century river town, is a worthwhile day trip 90 minutes west.
GETTING AROUND
A car is recommended. Free on-site parking. Janesville is straightforward to reach from Chicago, Milwaukee, and Madison via I-90/39.
THE NEIGHBORHOOD
Quieter than Lake Geneva. Quieter than the Dells. The property itself is private, tucked above the river, surrounded by mature trees that change beautifully with every season. Local restaurants, coffee shops, and groceries are a short drive away when you want them.
A FINAL NOTE
The Overhang was designed for memorable stays: slow mornings with pour-over coffee, evenings in the sauna as the sun drops behind the trees, nights gathered around the fire bowl under an open sky.
It's part of Outlandia, a small collection of architect-designed retreats in southern Wisconsin. Treat it the way it was made.

GUEST ACCESS:
Guests have full access to all three levels of the home and all designated outdoor spaces, including the hot tub, outdoor sauna, fire bowl patio, theater room, arcade, fitness equipment, balconies, and laundry.
For operational reasons, a small number of areas are not accessible: locked storage closets, the garage, and restricted river access points including the stairs leading to the water. All guest-accessible areas are clearly designated and entirely yours to enjoy.

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE:
Check-in: 3:00 PM | Checkout: 10:00 AM. Maximum guests: 10. No smoking anywhere on the property. No pets. No outside guests beyond your reserved party. We have a regular lawncare service that comes to the property on weekdays (usually on Wednesday but timing can vary depending on the weather). We welcome families, friend groups, and celebrations; we simply ask that gatherings stay within your reserved party and remain respectful of the property and neighbors. Large events or parties are not permitted. This is a professionally managed property maintained to a high standard. Please treat it with care.

NEIGHBORHOOD FIELD: (empty)  GETTING AROUND FIELD: (empty)

HOST BIO (shown on both of the host's listings): Hey there, I'm [host], your go-to host for a luxurious escape in nature! At Outlandia, it's all about epic stays with a mix of comfort, adventure, and relaxation. Whether you're here to soak up some serenity or dive into the outdoors, you're in for a treat. I've poured my passion into creating spaces that help you unwind, explore, and make memories. So kick off your shoes, breathe in that fresh air, and get ready for a getaway like no other!

Things to know: check-in 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM, checkout before 10:00 AM, self check-in with smart lock. Safety: exterior cameras, nearby lake/river/body of water, CO alarm.

## HOST-CONFIRMED FACTS (Nov 1, 2026, in the host's own words or from the host's records):
- Provides towels, sheets, soap, toilet paper, shampoo, conditioner, dish soap, body wash, hand soap.
- There is no work desk at the house.
- Rock River Heritage County Park is just down the road.
- Not handicap accessible; there are steps.
- Fireplaces are gas only; never describe a wood stove or wood fire.
- On the Rock River (a river, not a lake), quiet residential neighborhood. Sleeps 10. About 3,600 sq ft.
- No events of any kind; a bridal party may get ready there on a wedding day.
- Pricing is set in a separate tool and is out of scope.

## The proposed rewrite (nothing applied yet)
Amenity changes proposed: tick Essentials. Do not tick Dedicated workspace.

### summary
An architect-designed home on a private bluff above the Rock River in Janesville, under 2 hours from Chicago and 45 minutes from Madison. Sleeps 10 in four king bedrooms plus a queen sofa bed, with 3.5 baths. Private hot tub and outdoor sauna under the cantilever, a fire bowl patio over the river, a movie theater, an arcade and a gas fireplace. Built for families, friend groups and small team retreats.

### space
The Overhang sits on a private bluff above the Rock River, wrapped in charred-wood siding, with a giant round window that frames the water. It has three levels: one to gather, one to sleep, one to play.

Upper level: gather and cook
Reclaimed-wood ceiling beams and the round window over the river. A chef's kitchen with an oversized island and seating for five. A gas fireplace in the living room, a hammock chair, board games and a coffee bar with drip, French press and pour-over. The queen sofa bed is here for bigger groups.

Main level: sleep
Three king bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a spa-style bath with a microcement tub. A kitchenette for late snacks and early coffee. Doors open straight out to the hot tub, sauna and fire bowl patio.

Lower level: play and watch
A movie theater with a large screen and surround sound, an arcade, a fourth king bedroom and a full bathroom. Kids and teens can take this level over, and the king room down here suits anyone who wants some privacy.

Outdoors
The hot tub sits under the cantilevered house and looks out over the river. The sauna is a wood-lined room with a window to the trees. The fire bowl patio overlooks the river bluff. Mature trees surround the property. In winter, go from the sauna to the cold night air and back. In fall, the trees around the hot tub turn color.

Living room: queen sofa bed, upper level

Beloit's Ironworks district and Beloit College: 15 minutes. Lake Geneva: 50 minutes. Galena, IL, a 19th-century river town: 90 minutes, a good day trip on longer stays.

The Overhang is part of Outlandia, a small collection of architect-designed homes in southern Wisconsin.

### access
You have the whole house on all three levels and the outdoor spaces: the hot tub, outdoor sauna, fire bowl patio, theater, arcade, fitness equipment, balconies and laundry.

A few areas are closed to guests: locked storage closets, the garage, and the stairs and other paths down to the river.

You'll want a car. Parking is free on site, and there's a Level 2 EV charger. Janesville is right off I-90/39, an easy drive from Chicago, Milwaukee and Madison.
